voiceSummary: Kernex Microsystems India Limited has approved the grant of 25,000 stock options to eligible employees under the KMIL ESOS 2023 scheme. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee authorized this grant during its meeting on 14th November 2026. This action follows shareholder authority granted via Postal Ballot on August 23, 2024. Each option carries the right to apply for one equity share with a face value of Rs. 10. The exercise price per option is set at Rs. 25. Options will vest one year from the date of grant. The maximum number of shares arising from the exercise of these options is 25,000. The company has disclosed this information pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR regulations.

attchmntText: Kernex Microsystems (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kernex Microsystems India Limited approved un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The board granted 25,000 ESOPs to eligible employees. Profit for the half year ended 30th September 2026 was 23,885.41 lakhs. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was 54,263.17 lakhs. Basic earnings per share for the quarter was 76.78. The company has an aggregate outstanding order book of 3068 Crores including GST. Statutory auditors included an emphasis of matter regarding the recoverability of certain financial assets. Trade receivables amount to 422.73 lakhs with an expected credit loss provision of 41.30 lakhs. Bank guarantees of 265.03 lakhs are under arbitration proceedings. The board meeting was held on 14th November 2026.
